searchText: ***CONSIGNMENT*** Used Gulf Stream Class C RV for sale - 2024 Gulf Stream Conquest 6280D is approximately 30' 0' in length with 48,982 miles and 0 slides. Features Overhead Loft Jackknife Sofa Flip-Up Countertop More About This RV As you look forward to your next getaway, think about the many different ways that this Conquest Class C gas motorhome will come in handy! When you're tired after a long day of hiking, you won't have to search out a local restaurant because you'll be able to easily make your own dinner on the three-burner range in the kitchen, grab some condiments from the 10.2 cu. ft. 12V double-door refrigerator, and wash up the dirty dishes in the single bowl sink. When you just want to rest, you have quite a few choices for that too with the booth dinette, the jackknife sofa, the bunk above the cab, and the RV queen bed in the rear private bedroom. Each one of these Gulf Stream RV Conquest Class C gas motorhomes is built with a Cradle of Strength® on either the Ford E350 or E450 chassis depending on the model! Their construction also consists of a welded aluminum perimeter frame, an EPDM rubber roof, and high gloss white fiberglass sidewalls with Azdel substrate to prevent rotting. The included Conquest Luxury Package comes with vinyl flooring throughout for an easier clean, upgraded designer graphics, and a multimedia center with a 9' screen, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto and an AM/FM stereo. The exterior is just as accommodating with its hot and cold shower, 7,500 lb. hitch, electric awning with LED lights, and more!
